selector.rationale: Biopsy specimens demonstrated amyloid protein deposition and a systemic evaluation for amyloidosis revealed no additional disease manifestations, supporting localized urethral amyloidosis. Urethral stenosis is also present but is more of a symptom or finding rather than a diagnosis.

rejected.label: Primary Amyloidosis of the Urethra
rejected.why: Lack of specific evidence in the vignette to support this diagnosis over LocalizedUrethralAmyloidosis

rejected.why: Biopsy specimens were negative for carcinoma
